title: Existing-architecture resolution
description: The typed contract the resolve_existing resolver agent emits BEFORE the Architect designs. It decides whether the described system is NEW to the EA repository or an UPDATE to something already modelled, names the domain/folder the work belongs to, and matches BA element names to existing ADOIT objects so the Architect reuses their ids instead of duplicating them.

decision.description: `UPDATE` if the input clearly extends or revises a system/domain already present in the repository; otherwise `NEW`.

domain.description: The application/domain/system this work belongs to — an existing group/model name when candidates share one, else a concise new domain derived from the system name. Becomes the folder the model is organised under.

base_model.description: Optional: the existing model name when `decision` is UPDATE, else null.

matched.description: Open map of BA element name -> the existing ADOIT object it matches. Only genuine matches; new elements are omitted. Empty object when nothing matched.

rationale.description: Optional: one or two sentences a human reviewer will read explaining the decision and matches.

adoit_id.description: The exact id of the existing ADOIT object, reused verbatim by the Architect.

adoit_name.description: The existing object's exact name in ADOIT.
